data.name: Eve
data.message: Just finished calibrate distributor, heading to medbay

I found Diana's body in medbay. My route was cafeteria → electrical → medbay. At tick 6 when I was in electrical, I saw Frank there — and he had just come in from medbay. Then I went into medbay and found Diana dead. Frank is the most suspicious to me right now since he was coming straight from the crime scene.

I don't have much to add — my route was just navigation to storage, and I didn't see anyone the entire time. No bodies, no encounters. So I can't confirm or deny anyone's story directly.

That said, Eve's account of Frank coming out of medbay right before she found Diana there is pretty damning if true. I'd like to hear what Frank has to say for himself, and also whether anyone can vouch for Eve's route through cafeteria and electrical. Right now Frank is my top suspect, but I want to hear him out before locking in a vote.

My route was short — I started in storage, then moved to lower engine. I didn't see anyone the whole time, no bodies, no encounters. So I can't vouch for or accuse anyone directly from what I personally witnessed.

That said, Eve's testimony is pretty specific — she places Frank coming out of medbay right before she found Diana's body there. That's a strong lead. I want to hear Frank's route and whether he can explain being in medbay, and also whether Charlie saw anything that confirms or contradicts Eve. If Frank can't account for himself, he's my vote.

My route was simple — I spent the round between upper engine and oxygen, working on tasks. I went upper engine → oxygen → back to upper engine. I didn't see a single other player the entire time, and I didn't see any bodies. So unfortunately I can't vouch for anyone or directly contradict anyone.

That said, Eve's account is the strongest piece of evidence we have. She places Frank walking out of medbay right before she discovered Diana's body there. If Frank had a legitimate task in medbay, fine — but he needs to explain it, and ideally someone needs to confirm seeing him elsewhere earlier. Bob and Alice were both isolated like me, so none of us can clear or condemn anyone.

I'm leaning Frank unless his speech gives a really solid alibi. If he claims he was just passing through, I want to know where he came from before medbay and whether anyone saw him there.

Hold on, Eve is completely twisting this. 

First of all, to prove I'm being honest about my route: Charlie, I can confirm your story. I started in oxygen and saw you there right at tick 1. From there, I went to upper engine, and then I passed through medbay on my way to electrical to do my calibration task. 

Eve is telling the truth that we passed each other as I entered electrical, but here is the most important part: Diana was ALIVE when I walked through medbay. I just passed right by her. Eve, you walked into medbay right after I left, killed Diana, and instantly self-reported to frame me! 

Think about it logically, guys: if I had just killed Diana, why would I casually stroll straight into electrical right into Eve's face instead of leaving towards storage or the cafeteria? Eve saw me leave medbay, realized she had the perfect scapegoat, took the opportunity for a free kill, and hit the report button. 

This is a classic self-report frame job. I'm voting Eve. If you vote me out and see I'm a Goose, you'll know exactly who to vote next.

Wait, I already gave my speech first — but since I'm being directly accused, let me respond.

Frank, your "logic" actually cuts against you, not me. You admit you were in medbay with Diana right before I arrived. You're the last person confirmed with her alive. The self-report argument goes both ways — if I were the Duck, why would I report immediately after being seen leaving the scene with you as a witness? That's the worst possible play. I reported because I found a body and that's what Geese do.

Also, Frank claims he saw Charlie in oxygen at tick 1 — but Charlie just said he didn't see a single other player the entire round. That's a direct contradiction. Charlie, please confirm: was Frank in oxygen with you or not? Because if Frank is lying about seeing Charlie to fake an alibi, that's our Duck right there.

My vote is staying on Frank unless Charlie backs up his oxygen claim.

Okay, this is a huge development. Eve just caught what might be a critical contradiction. Frank claims he saw Charlie in oxygen at tick 1, but Charlie explicitly said he didn't see a single other player the entire round. Those two statements cannot both be true.

Charlie, you need to clarify right now — were you in oxygen at tick 1, and was Frank there with you? If Frank was there and you just missed mentioning him, say so. But if Frank was never in oxygen with you, then he just fabricated an alibi in real time to save himself, and that's basically a confession.

Eve's self-report argument is also solid — reporting right after being seen leaving the scene with a witness is terrible Duck play. Frank being the last confirmed person with Diana alive is much more damning.

I'm leaning hard toward Frank now, but I want Charlie's answer before I lock it in. Charlie, this is on you — your word decides this vote.

I already gave my speech earlier, but since the situation has shifted dramatically, let me add my voice here too.

The contradiction Eve caught is huge. Frank explicitly said "Charlie, I can confirm your story. I started in oxygen and saw you there right at tick 1." But Charlie already told us he didn't see a single other player the entire round. Those statements cannot coexist. Either Charlie missed Frank somehow, or Frank just made up an alibi on the spot.

Charlie, we need your answer. If Frank was genuinely in oxygen with you at tick 1, say so now — even if you forgot to mention him initially. But if you're certain you were alone in oxygen, then Frank fabricated that alibi under pressure, and combined with him being the last person seen with Diana alive, that's our Duck.

My vote is on Frank unless Charlie explicitly confirms seeing him in oxygen.

I need to be absolutely clear here, because my answer decides this vote.

Frank, you are lying. I was in upper engine at tick 1, NOT oxygen. I only moved to oxygen later in the round, and when I was in oxygen, I was completely alone. I never saw you. Not in oxygen, not in upper engine, not anywhere. You couldn't have "seen me in oxygen at tick 1" because I wasn't there, and you were never in oxygen with me at any point.

That's a fabricated alibi, plain and simple. You tried to name-drop me to manufacture a witness, and it backfired because I actually was paying attention to where I was.

Combined with Eve placing you walking out of medbay right before Diana's body was found there — and you admitting you were in medbay with Diana — this is clear cut. You're the Duck.

My vote is Frank.

Charlie, you are either completely oblivious or you're intentionally lying to get me voted out. At tick 1, you literally walked from upper engine INTO oxygen. I was right there. I don't know how you didn't see me, maybe I was in the corner doing the filter task and you weren't paying attention, but you *were* there. 

Eve is playing you all like a fiddle. She walked into medbay right after me, killed Diana, and immediately self-reported because she knew she had me as a scapegoat. She capitalized on Charlie's bad memory to seal the deal. 

I know I'm probably dead here because the mob mentality has taken over. But I am a Goose. When you vote me out and the game doesn't end, you will know 100% that Eve is the Duck who orchestrated this entire frame job. 

My vote is staying on Eve. Don't say I didn't warn you.
